title: AW28 Women's Category Opportunities
summary: Projected growth for AW28 women: coats, skirt suits, suede, colour knits.
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 fabric fairs take place in September 2027 and the shows in early 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fabric fairs, SS28 previews and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Pink becomes a neutral base ("Pink standard"), from soft blush to greyish dusty rose, no longer limited to womenswear; rosehip is a standout pink; suggested for blazers, skirt suits and voile dresses with ruffles or lace<sup>[1]</sup>
- Deep classic brown in leather and leather-look pieces, sporty pieces and tailoring, suited to suede and canvas-like materials<sup>[1]</sup>
- Future Snoops' AW28/29 "Blocked brights": "Bold colour becomes an act of defiance, a refusal to disappear into the algorithmic mass"; blue leads, with red and purple rising, and cornflower as a new "anchor colour"<sup>[1]</sup>
- AW27 fairs made wool lighter and softer, brought back double-faced woollens and hid performance inside classic suitings<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Opportunities
sections.body:
1. Coats.
2. Skirt suits.
3. Suede and leather-look.
4. Colour knits.
5. Romantic dresses.

sections.heading: Reduce
sections.body: Styles that did not sell through in the previous comparable season.

design_implications: - Shift development time to the opportunities.
